title: Spanish Pasta with Gorgonzola
description: A creamy pasta dish with a tangy Spanish twist. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: gorgonzola
ingredients.notes: don't overdo it, gorgonzola can be strong

ingredients.name: crunchy
ingredients.notes: fresh from the garden is best

ingredients.name: spanish
ingredients.notes: adds a smoky depth to the dish

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the gorgonzola and stir until smooth and creamy.
Add the nutty and crunchy ingredients and stir to combine.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to coat with the gorgonzola sauce.
If the sauce seems too thick, add a bit of the reserved pasta water.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
